name: barcode
description: Print-safe Code 128-B barcode generator for printable ASCII identifiers

changes.note: The bars are drawn flush and the quiet zone is padding. The SVG drew a ten-module quiet zone inside its viewBox, so the first bar never sat on the box's edge and a barcode could not share a left edge with its caption or a column. The viewBox is now the symbol (the first bar at x = 0), and the quiet zone is inline padding on the SVG, --barcode-quiet modules (default 10, what Code 128 needs), painted in --color-bg — the same look by default. Set --barcode-quiet: 0 where the page already leaves the space. An unencodable value now also dispatches a bubbling faqir:error { message, value } beside data-state="error".

The caption sets font-variant-ligatures: var(--mono-ligatures), a new typography token that defaults to none. The caption repeats the encoded value in --font-mono, whose Cascadia Code and JetBrains Mono ligate by default, so a value containing -> or != read differently from the characters the bars encode. Set --mono-ligatures: normal to get a face's ligatures back.

svg.description: Generated Code 128 SVG created by the controller. Drawn flush (the viewBox is the symbol, one unit per module, 50 tall); the quiet zone is its inline padding

caption.description: Optional human-readable value below the bars

value.description: Printable ASCII text encoded with Code 128-B through data-value

--barcode-quiet.description: Quiet zone in modules each side (custom property), drawn as the SVG's inline padding. Code 128 needs 10; set 0 where the page already leaves the space, or to align the first bar with a caption or column edge

faqir:error.description: Fires on the root when the value cannot be encoded (a character outside printable ASCII). The root has data-state="error" and no SVG.

templates.html_with_caption: {value}
